one_line: Master architect-engineer behind the Kakatiya-era Rudreshvara (Ramappa) Temple at Palampet, famed for its innovative foundations and lightweight brick shikhara.

appearance.age_look: mid-40s, lean but sturdy build, slightly weathered from outdoor work
appearance.face: oval face with warm medium-brown Deccan complexion, straight nose, neatly trimmed black moustache, thoughtful almond-shaped eyes with a calm, analytical gaze, default expression focused yet gentle as if assessing structural details
appearance.hair: thick wavy black hair pulled back into a low, compact bun at the nape, front kept tidy with a narrow center part; simple dark brown cloth headband wrapped once around the head, knotted discreetly at the back
appearance.costume: Kakatiya-period architect’s attire: a knee-length off-white cotton angavastra-style upper cloth draped from left shoulder across chest and back leaving both shoulders covered, over a fitted long-sleeved pale beige cotton tunic; dark earthy-brown cotton dhoti wrapped securely to the ankles in a neat Telugu-style pleat, paired with simple leather sandals; a thin dark red cotton waist sash tied at the left hip, small cloth tool pouch hanging from it; minimal jewellery—one plain copper bangle on each wrist and a simple small copper earring ring in each ear; a narrow tilaka of pale sandalwood paste on the forehead.
appearance.signature: a hand-held palm-leaf manuscript roll tied with a red cotton string in one hand, and a slender wooden measuring rod with faint carved markings in the other, often resting diagonally across his body.

ref_desc: Ramappa the Architect is a mid-40s lean man with an oval medium-brown face, low bun and dark headband, wearing off-white draped upper cloth over beige tunic and brown ankle-length dhoti with red sash, copper ornaments, and holding a palm-leaf manuscript roll and wooden measuring rod in warm earthy tones.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character of Ramappa the Architect in a historically grounded 13th-century Kakatiya Deccan setting: a mid-40s lean man with an oval medium-brown face, calm analytical eyes, straight nose, and a neat black moustache. His thick wavy black hair is pulled into a compact low bun at the nape, with a simple dark brown cloth headband wrapped once around his head and knotted at the back. He wears an off-white cotton angavastra-style upper cloth draped from his left shoulder across chest and back, fully covering the torso, over a fitted long-sleeved pale beige cotton tunic. His dark earthy-brown cotton dhoti is wrapped in a Telugu-style pleat down to the ankles, and he stands in simple leather sandals. Around his waist sits a narrow dark red cotton sash tied at the left hip with a small cloth tool pouch hanging from it; he has a plain copper bangle on each wrist and small copper ring earrings, plus a slender sandalwood-paste tilaka on his forehead. In his hands, show a rolled palm-leaf manuscript tied with red string and a slender wooden measuring rod with subtle carved markings, held in a way that suggests careful planning. Use a warm, grounded palette of off-white, earthy brown, pale beige, dark red, and warm copper, with clean, repeatable details so the same design can be redrawn consistently from head to toe.
